seoTitle: Final Grade Calculator - What Grade Do You Need?
metaDescription: Free online Final Grade Calculator. Find out exactly what score you need on your final exam to achieve your desired class grade.
secondaryKeywords: what do I need on my final
intro: Stressing about finals week? Our free Final Grade Calculator tells you exactly what score you need to get on your final exam to achieve your target grade for the class.
whatIs: The Final Grade Calculator is a predictive math tool that reverses the grading formula. It calculates the minimum score required on a final test to reach a specific overall course percentage.
howToUse: Enter your current overall class grade (e.g., 85%).
Enter the target grade you want to achieve for the class (e.g., 90%).
Enter the weight of the final exam (e.g., 20%).
The tool instantly reveals the exact score needed on the final.
howItWorks: The calculator uses a simple algebraic formula: Final Exam Score = (Target Grade - Current Grade × (100% - Final Weight)) / Final Weight. It solves this equation instantly to isolate the required exam score.
workedExample: You have an 85% in class. You want a 90%. The final is worth 20%. The formula calculates: (90 - 85 × 0.80) / 0.20 = (90 - 68) / 0.20 = 22 / 0.20 = 110%. You would need 110% on the final to get an A.
resultInterpretation: The output tells you the exact percentage you must score on the final test. If the required score is over 100%, it means the target grade is mathematically impossible without extra credit.
useCases: Study Prioritization: Deciding which classes require the most intense studying based on whether target grades are realistic.
Stress Reduction: Realizing you only need a 40% on a final to keep your passing grade.
Goal Setting: Setting a concrete target score to aim for during test preparation.
tipsAndLimitations: Ensure you are entering your current grade exactly as it stands. If there are ungraded assignments pending, this calculation will change.
The final exam weight must be entered as a percentage (e.g., 20, not 0.2).

faq.question: What if the required score is over 100%?
faq.answer: This means it is mathematically impossible to reach your target grade using only the final exam. You would need extra credit or grades raised on previous assignments.

faq.question: What if the required score is negative?
faq.answer: Congratulations! A negative required score means you have already locked in your target grade. Even if you score a zero on the final, you will still achieve your goal.

cta: Find out what you need on your final exam!
disclaimer: This tool uses pure mathematics to calculate required scores. Be aware that some professors have specific policies (like failing the class if you fail the final, regardless of math).
